slides.statSub: games between first place and last
slides.say:
Twelve teams. Nobody is 5‑1. Nobody is 1‑5.
The tightest it's been after six weeks in any season since 2021.

slides.title: The whole league
slides.kicker: A five‑way tie for first. The most ever tied at the top after six weeks was three, in 2022.

slides.title: The gap after Week 6, every year
slides.kicker: Before this year, first and last had never been within two games past Week 3.

slides.title: 4‑2 teams made the playoffs 11 of 16 times
slides.say:
2‑4 teams made it 3 of 16.
Then again, the 2024 title game was David vs. Hoa, and both of them were 2‑4 after Week 6.

slides.title: Every record on the board has won this league
slides.say:
Drew was 3‑3 in 2021.
Matt was 4‑2 in 2023.
David was 2‑4 in 2024.

The tie at the top breaks this week:
Wes plays Adam.
